cards.summary: Agent4Crypto是一个面向加密货币交易的多智能体系统，协调数据收集、分析、风险评估、反思与交易等专用智能体，从价格、指标、新闻和图表中合成异构信号。其核心设计是交易员中心决策机制：三个风格特定的交易员智能体（激进、中性、保守）生成候选动作与自然语言理由，其影响力由基于PPO的门控策略动态分配，该策略利用双反思反馈——一个反思流评估交易后决策质量并提炼可复用经验存入金融推理库，另一个估计交易员级反事实贡献。实验表明，在BTC、ETH和XRP上，该系统在总回报和夏普比率上优于传统策略、机器学习与强化学习基线以及现有基于LLM的交易系统。
cards.title: Agent4Crypto：双反思市场反馈对齐的多智能体加密货币交易系统
cards.descriptionEn: Proposes an LLM-based multi-agent trading framework that dynamically learns the influence of trader agents with different styles through dual-reflection mechanisms and market-feedback alignment, enhancing interpretability and adaptability in cryptocurrency trading.
cards.titleEn: Agent4Crypto: A Dual-Reflective and Market-Feedback-Aligned LLM-Based Multi-Agent System for Cryptocurrency Trading
keyPoints: 系统采用双反思机制：一个评估交易后决策质量并提炼经验，另一个估计交易员级反事实贡献，以动态调整交易员权重。
基于PPO的门控策略将反事实贡献记忆与市场特征、先前交易员权重及当前交易员动作结合，使交易员影响力适应牛、震荡、熊市不同市场状态。
在BTC、ETH和XRP上的实验显示，总回报和夏普比率优于传统策略、机器学习与强化学习基线及现有LLM交易系统。
cards.originalTitle: Agent4Crypto: A Dual-Reflective and Market-Feedback-Aligned LLM-Based Multi-Agent System for Cryptocurrency Trading
cards.limitationsEn: Experiments are limited to three cryptocurrencies (BTC, ETH, XRP), constraining sample scope; performance relies on the stability of LLM and PPO training, and generalization under extreme market conditions is unverified; backtest results may be subject to overfitting, and execution delays, slippage, and liquidity risks in live trading are not evaluated; the long-term effectiveness of the Financial ReasoningBank and the accuracy of counterfactual contribution estimation require further validation.
keyPointsEn: The system employs a dual-reflection mechanism: one stream evaluates post-trade decision quality and distills lessons, while the other estimates trader-level counterfactual contribution to dynamically adjust trader weights.

A PPO-based gating policy combines counterfactual contribution memory with market features, previous trader weights, and current trader actions, enabling trader influence to adapt across bull, sideways, and bear market regimes.

Experiments on BTC, ETH, and XRP demonstrate higher total return and Sharpe ratio compared to traditional strategies, machine learning and reinforcement learning baselines, and existing LLM-based trading systems.
cards.whyItMatters: 加密货币市场的高频与非平稳特性对自主AI代理构成挑战，现有方法常面临决策不透明和聚合规则固定的问题。Agent4Crypto通过可解释的交易员竞争和市场反馈驱动的自适应机制，为构建更透明、适应性更强的LLM交易系统提供了新思路。
cards.summaryEn: Agent4Crypto is a multi-agent system for cryptocurrency trading that coordinates specialized agents for data collection, analysis, risk assessment, reflection, and trading, synthesizing heterogeneous signals from prices, indicators, news, and charts. Its central design is a trader-centric decision mechanism: three style-specific trader agents (Aggressive, Neutral, Conservative) generate candidate actions and natural-language rationales, with their influence dynamically allocated by a PPO-based gating policy that leverages dual-reflective feedback—one reflection stream evaluates post-trade decision quality and distills reusable lessons into a Financial ReasoningBank, while the other estimates trader-level counterfactual contribution. Experiments on BTC, ETH, and XRP show that the system improves total return and Sharpe ratio over traditional strategies, machine learning and reinforcement learning baselines, and existing LLM-based trading systems.
cards.limitations: 实验仅涵盖BTC、ETH和XRP三种加密货币，样本范围有限；系统性能依赖LLM和PPO训练稳定性，在极端市场条件下的泛化能力未经验证；回测结果可能受过拟合影响，实际交易中的执行延迟、滑点和流动性风险未纳入评估；金融推理库的长期有效性及反事实贡献估计的准确性仍需进一步检验。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The high-frequency and non-stationary nature of cryptocurrency markets poses challenges for autonomous AI agents, and existing methods often suffer from opaque decisions and fixed aggregation rules. Agent4Crypto offers a new approach to building more transparent and adaptive LLM-based trading systems through interpretable trader competition and market-feedback-driven adaptation.
cards.description: 提出一种基于LLM的多智能体交易框架，通过双反思机制与市场反馈对齐，动态学习不同风格交易员的影响力，提升加密货币交易的可解释性与适应性。

cards.summary: 研究对比了在历史数据回放、GBM、SABR及混合环境中训练的期权对冲强化学习智能体。样本外测试（2018-2023）显示，实证数据训练的智能体相比Delta对冲降低CVaR尾部损失3.1%，在波动下跌市场中降幅达8.9%，但在上涨市场中反而增加7-10%成本。作者认为实证训练诱导了状态依赖的净Delta空头，使策略在价格下跌后对冲不足。
cards.title: 实证数据训练提升期权做市商尾部风险对冲
cards.descriptionEn: The study trains a distributional TD3 agent in an empirical replay environment built from real S&P 500 options data and compares its out-of-sample tail-risk performance against agents trained in simulated markets and traditional hedging strategies, finding that empirical training reduces CVaR but the advantage is regime-dependent.
cards.titleEn: Empirical Data Training Improves Tail-Risk Hedging for Options Market Makers
keyPoints: 实证回放环境训练的智能体在2018-2023样本外降低CVaR尾部损失3.1%（相对Delta对冲），波动下跌市场降幅达8.9%。
该优势在上涨市场中逆转为7-10%的成本增加，表现具有状态依赖性。
实证训练诱导状态依赖的净Delta空头，在负Delta账簿上对冲不足，价格下跌后尤为明显；该倾斜在GBM训练中消失，在SABR或混合训练中较弱。
cards.originalTitle: Risk-Sensitive Reinforcement Learning for an Options Market Maker: An Empirical Study with Real S&P 500 Options
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is based on a single test path (2018-2023); the advantage is regime-conditional and becomes a cost in rising markets; generalization to other markets or asset classes is not considered; the empirical replay environment relies on historical data, and future market structure changes may affect strategy performance.
keyPointsEn: The agent trained in the empirical replay environment reduces out-of-sample CVaR tail loss by 3.1% (vs. delta hedging) over 2018-2023, reaching 8.9% in volatile falling markets.
The advantage reverses to a 7-10% cost increase in rising markets, indicating regime dependence.

Empirical training induces a state-dependent short net delta, under-hedging negative-delta books, especially after price declines; this tilt disappears with GBM training and is weaker with SABR or hybrid training.
cards.whyItMatters: 表明训练环境的历史动态特征会实质性改变尾部风险对冲策略，单纯依赖模型生成市场可能低估真实风险，为期权做市商的风险管理提供实证训练视角。
cards.summaryEn: The study compares option hedging reinforcement learning agents trained in historical data replay, GBM, SABR, and hybrid environments. Out-of-sample tests (2018-2023) show the empirically trained agent reduces CVaR tail loss by 3.1% versus delta hedging, with an 8.9% reduction in volatile falling markets, but incurs a 7-10% cost in rising markets. The authors suggest empirical training induces a state-dependent short net delta, leading to under-hedging after price declines.
cards.limitations: 证据仅基于单一测试路径（2018-2023）；优势是状态条件性的，在上涨市场中表现为成本；未考虑其他市场或资产类别的泛化性；实证回放环境依赖历史数据，未来市场结构变化可能影响策略表现。
cards.whyItMattersEn: It shows that historical dynamics in the training environment can materially alter tail-risk hedging policies; relying solely on model-generated markets may underestimate real risks, offering an empirical training perspective for options market makers' risk management.
cards.description: 该研究在真实标普500期权数据构建的实证回放环境中训练分布式TD3智能体，并与模拟市场训练的智能体及传统对冲策略比较样本外尾部风险表现，发现实证训练可降低CVaR，但优势具有市场状态依赖性。

cards.summary: SAMBoost 是一种梯度提升方法，通过单一惩罚目标将树基协变量模型与 SPDE 潜在空间场结合，在每次迭代中分解预测器为协变量和空间两部分。作者称其在模拟和开放基准上匹配或优于联合高斯过程与树提升方法的预测精度，同时更快且更准确地恢复空间场和协变量效应。在 490 万条洪水保险组合数据上，该方法全量训练无需子采样，运行速度约为贝叶斯参考的十六倍。
cards.title: SAMBoost：融合SPDE空间场的梯度提升方法
cards.descriptionEn: SAMBoost combines tree-based covariate modeling with an SPDE latent spatial field in a single penalized objective, separating covariate and spatial components within boosting iterations so the spatial effect can be interpreted on its own; it matches or improves predictive accuracy of joint GP and tree boosting on simulations and an open benchmark while being faster and recovering spatial and covariate effects more accurately, and trains on the full 4.9-million-record flood in
cards.titleEn: SAMBoost: Gradient Boosting with an SPDE Latent Spatial Field
keyPoints: 在提升循环内同时建模非线性协变量效应和可解释的空间风险面，空间分量不被视为 nuisance。
底层网格产生稀疏精度结构，计算成本大致与样本量无关。
模拟与开放基准上预测精度匹配或优于联合 GP 与树提升方法，且更快、恢复更准；含交互时优于加性贝叶斯空间模型。
洪水保险组合（490 万条）全量训练，约比贝叶斯参考快十六倍，空间风险面一致。
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes mainly from simulations reported by the authors, one open benchmark, and one flood insurance portfolio; no systematic comparison across additional datasets is provided, and failure boundaries under complex spatial structure or small sample sizes are not discussed. A public Python implementation is available, but independent reproduction and third-party evaluation have not been reported.
keyPointsEn: Models nonlinear covariate effects and an interpretable spatial risk surface within the boosting loop, treating the spatial component as a quantity of interest rather than a nuisance.
The underlying mesh yields a sparse precision structure whose cost is largely independent of sample size.

Matches or improves predictive accuracy of joint GP and tree boosting on simulations and an open benchmark, is faster and recovers effects more accurately, and outperforms additive Bayesian spatial models when covariate interactions are present.
Trains on the full 4.9-million-record flood insurance portfolio about sixteen times faster than a Bayesian reference with a consistent spatial risk surface.
cards.whyItMatters: 对需要同时报告灵活协变量效应和独立地理风险面的应用（如保险定价）提供了一种计算上可扩展的联合建模路径，避免在灵活性与显式空间推断之间做取舍。
cards.summaryEn: SAMBoost is a gradient boosting method that combines tree-based covariate modeling with an SPDE latent spatial field through a single penalized objective, decomposing the predictor into covariate and spatial components at each iteration. The authors report that it matches or improves the predictive accuracy of joint Gaussian process and tree boosting approaches on simulations and an open benchmark, while being faster and recovering the spatial field and covariate effects more accurately. On a flood insurance portfolio with 4.9 million records, it trains on the full training set without subsampling and runs about sixteen times faster than a Bayesian reference.
cards.limitations: 证据主要来自作者报告的模拟、一个开放基准和一个洪水保险组合；未提供与其他方法在更多数据集上的系统比较，也未讨论模型假设在空间结构复杂或样本量较小时的失效边界。公开 Python 实现可用，但独立复现与第三方评估尚未见报道。
cards.whyItMattersEn: For applications that require reporting both flexible covariate effects and a standalone geographic risk surface, such as insurance pricing, it offers a computationally scalable joint modeling path without trading off flexibility against explicit spatial inference.
cards.description: SAMBoost 将树基协变量建模与 SPDE 潜在空间场结合于单一惩罚目标，在提升迭代中分离协变量与空间分量，使空间效应可独立解释；在模拟与开放基准上预测精度不逊于联合 GP 与树提升方法，且更快、空间与协变量效应恢复更准，并在 490 万条洪水保险数据上全量训练、比贝叶斯参考快约十六倍。

cards.summary: 研究比较了量子时序卷积网络中量子层的训练、冻结与缺失等六种条件，并使用四个滚动窗口、五个随机种子、bootstrap区间与多重检验校正。两个单侧检验显示，训练电路与冻结电路的差异落在0.03年化夏普以内，即电路效果等价于冻结而非仅仅无法区分。没有任何条件与零收益可区分，最佳Deflated Sharpe Ratio仅0.17。
cards.title: 量子层在股票横截面排序中的可识别贡献检验
cards.descriptionEn: The study designs an ablation protocol that separates the contribution of a quantum circuit from surrounding classical components in a hybrid quantum-classical model, tested on daily cross-sectional ranking of 2000 Tokyo Stock Exchange equities. Its novelty lies in a statistical framework that distinguishes trained versus frozen circuits rather than reporting only aggregate returns.
cards.titleEn: Identifying What a Quantum Layer Contributes to Cross-Sectional Equity Ranking
keyPoints: 训练与冻结量子电路的年化夏普差异被界定在0.03以内，统计上等价。
所有实验条件均无法与零收益区分，最佳Deflated Sharpe Ratio为0.17。
在盈利窗口的留出集与美国股票样本中复现了消融结果，后者所有条件均亏损。
cards.originalTitle: Trained, Frozen, or Absent: Identifying What a Quantum Layer Contributes to Cross-Sectional Equity Ranking
cards.limitationsEn: Conclusions are limited to 2000 Tokyo Stock Exchange equities, a daily cross-sectional ranking task, and four walk-forward folds under a specific protocol; the equivalence interval depends on the minimum detectable effect setting and cannot be generalised to claim quantum layers are universally ineffective. The holdout reproduces only on one profitable window, and the US equity sample loses money in all conditions, bounding evidence to the tested models and markets.
keyPointsEn: The trained-versus-frozen circuit difference is bounded within 0.03 annualised Sharpe, indicating statistical equivalence.
No experimental condition is distinguishable from zero returns; the best Deflated Sharpe Ratio is 0.17.
The ablation is reproduced on a profitable holdout window and on 2000 US equities, where every condition loses money.
cards.whyItMatters: 该工作提供了一种将量子组件贡献从经典基线中剥离的统计检验范式，有助于避免把混合模型整体表现误归因于量子电路。对量化研究者而言，其价值在于可识别性设计与多重检验控制，而非收益结论。
cards.summaryEn: The research compares six conditions—trained, frozen, and absent quantum layers, plus a parameter-matched classical surrogate and circuit-only variants—within a quantum temporal convolutional network, using four walk-forward folds with five seeds, bootstrap intervals, and multiple-testing corrections. Two one-sided tests place the trained-versus-frozen difference within 0.03 annualised Sharpe, meaning the circuit is equivalent to a frozen one rather than merely indistinguishable. No condition is distinguishable from zero, with the best Deflated Sharpe Ratio at 0.17.
cards.limitations: 结论仅基于2000只东京证券交易所股票、日频横截面排序任务及四个滚动窗口的特定协议；电路等价性的检验区间依赖最小可检测效应设定，不能推广为量子层普遍无效。留出集仅在一个盈利窗口复现，美国股票样本全部亏损，证据边界限于所测试的模型与市场。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The work offers a statistical testing paradigm for isolating a quantum component's contribution from classical baselines, helping avoid misattributing a hybrid model's overall performance to the quantum circuit. For quantitative researchers, its value lies in the identifiability design and multiple-testing control rather than in return conclusions.
cards.description: 该研究设计了一套消融协议，将混合量子-经典模型中量子电路的贡献与周围经典组件分离，并在东京证券交易所2000只股票的日频横截面排序任务上检验。其新意在于用量化统计框架区分“训练”与“冻结”电路的效果，而非仅报告整体收益。

cards.summary: 传统风险度量依赖单一概率模型，可能遗漏其他模型信息并导致风险评估偏差。作者提出DRP框架，将资产多样化与风险模型多样化结合，以指数聚合函数评估组合风险，并基于多模型的风险感知优化权重。作为实例，作者构建DRP-ES并推导理论性质与参数敏感性边界；美国、中国A股和韩国股市的实证表明，基于DRP-ES的策略在夏普比率和最大回撤上优于市场基准，且比单一模型资产多样化策略更稳定。
cards.title: 多样化风险感知风险度量与投资组合选择
cards.descriptionEn: Proposes a DRP risk measure framework integrating asset diversification and risk model diversification to reduce reliance on a single probability model. Novelty lies in an exponential aggregation function, multi-model weight optimization, and theoretical properties with sensitivity bounds for DRP-ES; usefulness is shown by superior and more robust strategy performance in multi-market backtests.
cards.titleEn: Diversified-Risk-Perception Risk Measures and Portfolio Selection
keyPoints: DRP框架同时考虑资产多样化与风险模型多样化，通过指数聚合函数强调大损失并汇总所有损失成分。
引入多个风险模型并基于其风险感知优化权重，提出DRP-ES并建立理论性质与模型参数敏感性边界。
在美国、中国A股和韩国股市的实验中，DRP-ES策略的夏普比率更高、最大回撤更低，且跨市场跨时期表现更稳健。
cards.originalTitle: Diversified-Risk-Perception Risk Measures and Portfolio Selection
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is based on specific samples and periods in U.S., Chinese A-share, and South Korean stock markets, so generalization requires caution; empirical performance of DRP-ES depends on the selected set of risk models and the weight optimization process, and results may change with the model set; transaction costs, liquidity constraints, and other practical implementation factors are not reported, and the theoretical bounds address only sensitivity to model parameters. This is not investment advice.
keyPointsEn: The DRP framework jointly considers asset diversification and risk model diversification, using an exponential aggregation function that emphasizes large losses while aggregating all loss components.
It incorporates multiple risk models and optimizes their weights based on risk perceptions, proposing DRP-ES with theoretical properties and sensitivity bounds to model parameters.
Experiments in U.S., Chinese A-share, and South Korean stock markets show DRP-ES strategies have higher Sharpe ratios, lower maximum drawdowns, and more robust performance across markets and periods.
cards.whyItMatters: 该框架为投资组合风险管理提供了一种降低单一模型依赖的度量思路，有望提升风险评估的全面性与策略在不同市场环境下的稳定性。
cards.summaryEn: Traditional risk measures rely on a single probability model, potentially overlooking information from alternative models and causing biased risk assessments. The authors propose a DRP framework that combines asset diversification with risk model diversification, evaluates portfolio risk via an exponential aggregation function, and optimizes weights based on multiple models' risk perceptions. They introduce DRP-ES, derive theoretical properties and parameter sensitivity bounds, and show in U.S., Chinese A-share, and South Korean stock markets that DRP-ES strategies achieve higher Sharpe ratios and lower maximum drawdowns than market benchmarks and are more stable than single-model asset diversification strategies.
cards.limitations: 证据基于美国、中国A股和韩国股市的特定样本与时期，结论外推需谨慎；DRP-ES的实证表现依赖于所纳入风险模型的选择与权重优化过程，模型集变化可能影响结果；文中未报告交易成本、流动性约束等实际实施因素，且理论边界仅针对模型参数敏感性，不构成投资建议。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The framework offers a risk measurement approach that reduces reliance on a single model, potentially improving the comprehensiveness of risk assessment and the stability of strategies across market environments.
cards.description: 提出DRP风险度量框架，融合资产多样化与风险模型多样化，以降低对单一概率模型的依赖。新在于引入指数聚合函数与多模型权重优化，并给出DRP-ES的理论性质与敏感性边界；有用性体现在多市场回测中策略表现更优且更稳健。

cards.summary: 来源以假设交易者为例：胜率 60% 与 30% 的两人在 10 笔后盈利相同，但盈亏比不同。作者指出，在假设固定胜率和独立交易下，低胜率高盈亏比的交易者出现长连亏的概率更高。以上为假设示例，未计成本，实际亏损可能聚集。
cards.title: 相同每笔优势下，胜率与盈亏比改变连亏深度
cards.descriptionEn: A hypothetical example shows that two traders with the same per-trade edge but different win rates and risk-reward ratios face very different probabilities of long losing streaks, helping quant researchers assess strategy stickiness.
cards.titleEn: Same per-trade edge, different losing streaks: win rate and risk-reward matter
keyPoints: 相同每笔期望优势下，胜率与盈亏比不同的策略，连亏概率差异明显。
示例中低胜率高盈亏比交易者出现 10 连亏的概率远高于高胜率交易者。
胜率和盈亏比共同影响连亏深度与交易者能否坚持系统。
cards.limitationsEn: The content is based on a hypothetical example before costs; it assumes fixed win rates and independent trades, while real losses can cluster. No real backtest or statistical test is provided, and it is not investment advice.
keyPointsEn: With the same per-trade edge, different win rates and risk-reward ratios lead to very different losing-streak probabilities.
In the example, the low-win-rate, high-risk-reward trader faces a far higher chance of 10 consecutive losses.
Win rate and risk-reward ratio jointly determine losing-streak depth and whether a trader can stick with the system.
cards.whyItMatters: 帮助量化研究者理解：仅看每笔期望优势不足以评估策略的可执行性，还需关注连亏分布对交易心理和资金曲线的影响。
cards.summaryEn: The source illustrates two hypothetical traders: one wins 60% and the other 30%, yet after 10 trades both are up the same amount due to different risk-reward ratios. It notes that under fixed win rates and independent trades, the low-win-rate trader has a much higher chance of 10 consecutive losses. This is a hypothetical example before costs, and real losses can cluster.
cards.limitations: 内容基于假设示例，未计交易成本；假设固定胜率和独立交易，而实际亏损可能聚集。未提供真实回测或统计检验，不构成投资建议。
cards.whyItMattersEn: It helps quant researchers see that per-trade edge alone is insufficient to evaluate a strategy's executability; the distribution of losing streaks affects trading psychology and equity curves.
cards.description: 该内容通过假设示例说明：胜率 60% 与 30% 的交易者若每笔期望优势相同，连亏概率显著不同，揭示盈亏比与胜率共同决定回撤体验，有助于理解策略可坚持性。

cards.summary: 论文指出，在多轮工具交互的智能体强化学习中，工具token不平衡、聚合放大和失败重试会导致工具信用为负，进而抑制工具调用能力。作者提出TACA方法，从调用发起和生成两方面监督推理到工具使用的过渡，包括优势投影、决策对比和监督回放。实验表明，TACA在六个推理基准上相比MT-GRPO提升了平均准确率，其中Qwen2.5-1.5B提升4.61个百分点，Qwen2.5-3B提升3.61个百分点。
cards.title: 智能体强化学习中的工具信用分配新方法TACA
cards.descriptionEn: This study identifies three coupled mechanisms behind tool-calling degradation in agentic reinforcement learning and proposes Transition-Aware Credit Assignment (TACA), which stabilizes tool use via advantage projection, decision contrast, and supervised replay, improving accuracy on multiple reasoning benchmarks.
cards.titleEn: TACA: Transition-Aware Credit Assignment for Tool Use in Agentic RL
keyPoints: 工具token不平衡、聚合放大和失败驱动重试三种机制耦合导致工具信用为负，抑制工具调用能力。
TACA通过优势投影强制工具调用token的平均优势非负，并用决策对比和监督回放引导工具使用决策与生成。
在六个推理基准上，TACA相比MT-GRPO将平均准确率提升4.61个百分点（Qwen2.5-1.5B）和3.61个百分点（Qwen2.5-3B）。
cards.originalTitle: When Credit Turns Against Tools: Transition-Aware Credit Assignment in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
cards.limitationsEn: The study is validated only on Qwen2.5-1.5B and Qwen2.5-3B across six reasoning benchmarks, without covering larger models or broader task types; the mechanistic explanations and TACA's effectiveness may depend on specific training settings and require further generalization testing.
keyPointsEn: Three coupled mechanisms—tool-token imbalance, aggregation amplification, and failure-driven retries—produce negative tool credit and suppress tool-calling ability.
TACA enforces nonnegative mean advantage on tool-call tokens via Advantage Projection and guides tool-use decisions and generation with Decision Contrast and Supervised Replay.
On six reasoning benchmarks, TACA raises mean accuracy over MT-GRPO by 4.61 percentage points for Qwen2.5-1.5B and 3.61 for Qwen2.5-3B.
cards.whyItMatters: 该方法针对智能体强化学习中工具调用能力退化的问题，提供了可操作的信用分配修正手段，有助于维持训练过程中工具交互的可靠性，对提升语言模型在复杂任务中的推理与工具使用表现具有参考价值。
cards.summaryEn: The paper shows that in agentic reinforcement learning with multi-turn tool interactions, tool-token imbalance, aggregation amplification, and failure-driven retries can produce negative tool credit and suppress tool-calling ability. The authors propose TACA, which supervises the transition from reasoning to tool use through Advantage Projection, Decision Contrast, and Supervised Replay. Experiments show that TACA improves mean accuracy over MT-GRPO on six reasoning benchmarks by 4.61 percentage points for Qwen2.5-1.5B and 3.61 for Qwen2.5-3B.
cards.limitations: 研究仅在Qwen2.5-1.5B和Qwen2.5-3B模型及六个推理基准上验证，未覆盖更大规模模型或更广泛的任务类型；所提机制的解释和TACA的有效性可能受具体训练设置影响，需进一步验证泛化性。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This method addresses tool-calling degradation in agentic reinforcement learning by providing an actionable credit-assignment correction, helping maintain reliable tool interaction during training and offering reference value for improving language models' reasoning and tool use in complex tasks.
cards.description: 该研究揭示智能体强化学习训练中工具调用能力下降的三种耦合机制，并提出过渡感知信用分配方法TACA，通过优势投影、决策对比和监督回放稳定工具使用，在多个推理基准上提升准确率。

cards.summary: 论文建立了一个多项式保持的离散时间框架，用于波动率建模和衍生品定价，通过有限维矩阵表示获得任意阶矩和序列交叉矩的精确解。作者提出两类新的随机波动率模型，并证明其在两种标度机制下弱收敛于多项式扩散和跳跃扩散。实证分析显示，新模型相比嵌套基准改善了收益率拟合，并将平均每周隐含波动率均方根误差降低约8-41%。
cards.title: 多项式保持框架：离散时间波动率建模新进展
cards.descriptionEn: Develops a discrete-time framework for volatility modelling and derivative pricing based on polynomial preservation, enabling exact moments and serial cross-moments via finite-dimensional matrix representations. Introduces two novel stochastic volatility models and shows empirical improvements in return fit and implied volatility errors.
cards.titleEn: Polynomial-Preserving Framework for Discrete-Time Volatility Modelling
keyPoints: 框架通过有限维矩阵表示实现任意阶矩与序列交叉矩的精确计算。
提出两类新随机波动率模型，可容纳灵活杠杆效应、方差之方差动态和非高斯新息。
在两种标度机制下证明弱收敛于多项式扩散和跳跃扩散，并建立离散矩递推与连续时间矩阵指数公式的联系。
cards.originalTitle: Polynomial-Preserving Processes and Volatility Modelling in Discrete Time
cards.limitationsEn: Empirical analysis is limited to S&P 500 returns and an options panel from 1996-2023, and does not cover other asset classes or markets. Convergence results are weak convergence, and finite-sample properties are not discussed. The magnitude of implied volatility error reduction depends on the specific variance dynamics and innovation distribution.
keyPointsEn: The framework achieves exact computation of arbitrary-order moments and serial cross-moments via finite-dimensional matrix representations.
Two novel stochastic volatility models accommodate flexible leverage, variance-of-variance dynamics, and non-Gaussian innovations.
Weak convergence to polynomial diffusions and jump-diffusions is proved under two scaling regimes, linking discrete moment recursions to continuous-time matrix-exponential formulas.
cards.whyItMatters: 该框架在保持解析可处理性的同时容纳灵活波动率动态，为离散时间波动率建模和衍生品定价提供了新工具，实证显示对S&P 500收益率拟合和期权隐含波动率预测有改进。
cards.summaryEn: The paper develops a polynomial-preserving discrete-time framework for volatility modelling and derivative pricing, obtaining exact moments of arbitrary order and serial cross-moments through finite-dimensional matrix representations. Two novel classes of stochastic volatility models are introduced, and weak convergence to polynomial diffusions and jump-diffusions is established under two scaling regimes. Empirical analysis shows improved return fit and approximately 8-41% reduction in mean weekly implied volatility RMSE relative to nested benchmarks.
cards.limitations: 实证仅限于S&P 500收益率和1996-2023年期权面板，未覆盖其他资产类别或市场；收敛性结果为弱收敛，未讨论有限样本性质；隐含波动率误差降低幅度依赖于方差动态和新息分布的具体设定。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The framework maintains analytical tractability while allowing flexible volatility dynamics, providing a new tool for discrete-time volatility modelling and derivative pricing. Empirically, it improves return fit and option implied volatility forecasts for the S&P 500.
cards.description: 提出基于多项式保持的离散时间波动率建模与衍生品定价框架，可精确计算任意阶矩与序列交叉矩，并引入两类新随机波动率模型。实证表明新模型改善收益率拟合，隐含波动率误差降低约8-41%。

cards.summary: DeepFinance基准由21个PE和IB端到端任务构成，平均需人类专业者27.1小时完成，每个任务配有约19个文件的数据室和平均84条专家评分标准。评估22种模型配置，最佳配置仅满足57.6%的评分标准，且前四名无统计显著差异。研究发现前沿模型常从错误输入正确计算，或找到关键证据却未据此行动。
cards.title: DeepFinance基准：AI处理PE/IB超长任务能力评估
cards.descriptionEn: DeepFinance is an ultra-long-horizon benchmark of 21 end-to-end private equity (PE) and investment banking (IB) tasks designed to assess AI on real-world diligence and deal work beyond retrieval and calculation. It provides a more workflow-aligned evaluation tool for quantitative research.
cards.titleEn: DeepFinance Benchmark: Evaluating AI on Ultra-Long-Horizon PE/IB Tasks
keyPoints: 基准包含21个超长程任务，平均人类耗时27.1小时，覆盖输出、工作流与判断三个维度。
最佳模型配置仅满足57.6%的评分标准，前四名配置在统计上不可区分。
前沿模型存在两类典型失败：基于错误输入的正确计算，以及找到决策相关证据但未采取行动。
cards.originalTitle: DeepFinance: Can AI Diligence a $100MM Deal?
cards.limitationsEn: The evaluation covers only 21 tasks and 22 model configurations, and the best configuration scores below 60%, indicating current AI capabilities remain limited; the statistical indistinguishability of the top four means ranking details are not robust. Although tasks and rubrics are expert-designed, they may not fully represent all PE/IB scenarios, and generalization of conclusions requires caution.
keyPointsEn: The benchmark includes 21 ultra-long-horizon tasks averaging 27.1 human hours, covering output, workflow, and judgment dimensions.
The best model configuration meets only 57.6% of rubric criteria, and the top four configurations are statistically indistinguishable.
Frontier models exhibit two typical failures: correct calculations from wrong inputs, and finding decision-relevant evidence without acting on it.
cards.whyItMatters: 该基准将AI评估从文档检索与数值正确性扩展到冲突来源选择、合理假设与可审计性等真实PE/IB核心能力，有助于更全面衡量模型在高风险金融工作流中的实际可用性。
cards.summaryEn: DeepFinance consists of 21 end-to-end PE and IB tasks that take a human professional an average of 27.1 hours, each paired with a data room averaging 19 files and graded against an average of 84 expert-written rubric criteria. Across 22 model configurations, the best configuration satisfies only 57.6% of rubric criteria, and the top four configurations are not statistically distinguishable. The study finds that frontier models often calculate correctly from wrong inputs or find decision-relevant evidence without acting on it.
cards.limitations: 评估仅覆盖21个任务和22种模型配置，且最佳配置得分不足60%，说明当前AI能力仍有限；前四名统计不可区分意味着排名细节不稳健。基准任务与评分标准虽经专家设计，但可能无法完全代表所有PE/IB场景，结论外推需谨慎。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This benchmark extends AI evaluation from document retrieval and numerical correctness to core real-world PE/IB capabilities such as resolving conflicting sources, making sound assumptions, and maintaining auditability, helping to more comprehensively measure model usability in high-stakes financial workflows.
cards.description: DeepFinance是一个面向私募股权与投资银行工作的超长程基准，包含21个端到端任务，旨在评估AI在真实尽调与交易工作中的表现，而非仅检索或计算。该基准为量化研究提供了更贴近实际工作流的评估工具。

cards.summary: 横截面股票收益预测面临低信噪比、高维因子和非平稳性等挑战，单一模型存在互补的失败模式：神经网络易过拟合噪声，线性模型易欠拟合非线性结构。作者提出异构集成框架，通过bagging组合线性与非线性预测器，利用预测误差的低交叉协方差实现误差抵消，并用偏差-方差-协方差分解形式化该机制。在CSI300日频Alpha158因子数据上，该集成方法在预测准确性和组合评估指标上均优于独立神经网络及XGBoost、Double Ensemble等树模型，Rank IC提升超过13%。以上为原文摘要陈述，尚未经独立验证。
cards.title: 异构集成学习提升横截面收益预测的分散化效应
cards.descriptionEn: The study extends financial diversification to the predictor level, proposing a heterogeneous ensemble framework that combines linear and nonlinear predictors to reduce cross-covariance of prediction errors. On CSI300 daily Alpha158 factor data, it achieves over 13% Rank IC improvement and outperforms tree-based models such as XGBoost.
cards.titleEn: Heterogeneous Ensemble Learning Enhances Cross-Sectional Return Prediction via Diversification
keyPoints: 提出异构集成框架，将线性与非线性预测器作为不同专家组合，利用误差低交叉协方差实现聚合时的误差抵消。
通过偏差-方差-协方差分解，建立预测器聚合与组合分散化之间的精确数学对应关系。
在CSI300日频Alpha158因子数据上，Rank IC较独立神经网络提升超过13%，并优于XGBoost和Double Ensemble等树模型。
cards.originalTitle: Diversification Across Predictors: Heterogeneous Ensemble Learning for Cross-Sectional Return Prediction
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is based on a single dataset (CSI300 daily Alpha158 factors) and specific model combinations, without covering other markets, frequencies, or factor sets; backtest results may be affected by data snooping, transaction costs, slippage, and market regimes, and lack long-term out-of-sample validation; computational complexity and overfitting risks of the ensemble are not fully discussed; conclusions should not be taken as investment advice.
keyPointsEn: Proposes a heterogeneous ensemble framework that combines linear and nonlinear predictors as distinct specialists, leveraging low cross-covariance of errors for error cancellation upon aggregation.
Establishes an exact mathematical correspondence between predictor aggregation and portfolio diversification via bias-variance-covariance decomposition.
On CSI300 daily Alpha158 factor data, achieves over 13% Rank IC improvement over standalone neural networks and outperforms tree-based models such as XGBoost and Double Ensemble.
cards.whyItMatters: 该工作为量化选股中的模型组合提供了理论解释和实证支持，表明在低信噪比环境下，通过异构预测器的分散化可以比单一复杂模型更有效地提升预测稳健性，对因子投资实践具有参考价值。
cards.summaryEn: Cross-sectional stock return prediction faces challenges of low signal-to-noise ratio, high dimensionality, and non-stationarity, with individual models exhibiting complementary failure modes: neural networks overfit noise while linear models underfit nonlinear structure. The authors propose a heterogeneous ensemble framework that combines linear and nonlinear predictors via bagging, leveraging low cross-covariance of prediction errors to cancel errors, and formalize the mechanism through bias-variance-covariance decomposition. On CSI300 daily Alpha158 factor data, the ensemble outperforms standalone neural networks and tree-based state-of-the-art methods including XGBoost and Double Ensemble in both predictive accuracy and portfolio-based metrics, with Rank IC improvement exceeding 13%. These are claims from the original abstract and have not been independently verified.
cards.limitations: 证据仅基于单一数据集（CSI300日频Alpha158因子）和特定模型组合，未涉及其他市场、频率或因子集；回测结果可能受数据窥探、交易成本、滑点及市场状态影响，未提供样本外长期验证；集成方法的计算复杂度和过拟合风险未充分讨论；结论不应视为投资建议。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This work provides theoretical explanation and empirical support for model combination in quantitative stock selection, showing that in low signal-to-noise environments, diversification across heterogeneous predictors can more effectively improve prediction robustness than a single complex model, offering reference value for factor investing practice.
cards.description: 该研究将金融分散化原理拓展到预测器层面，提出异构集成框架，通过组合线性与非线性预测器降低预测误差的交叉协方差，从而在中国CSI300日频Alpha158因子数据上实现Rank IC超过13%的提升，并优于XGBoost等树模型。

cards.summary: 视觉几何变换器在多视图三维重建中性能强大，但全局注意力层的计算成本随输入序列长度二次增长。作者提出一种简单通用的策略：限制每个查询在全局注意力中交互的键/值令牌数。实验表明，该方法在500张图像场景下加速超过85%，且保持或提升基线性能。
cards.title: 视觉几何变换器的高效令牌选择策略
cards.descriptionEn: This work proposes a two-stage token selection framework that reduces key/value tokens in global attention via inter-frame diversity selection and intra-frame entropy-guided sparsification, accelerating visual geometry transformers while maintaining performance.
cards.titleEn: Efficient Token Selection for Visual Geometry Transformers
keyPoints: 两阶段框架：帧间选择保留关键帧，帧内选择进一步丢弃冗余令牌。
帧间选择采用多样性策略以确保场景覆盖，帧内选择利用全局注意力熵进行层感知稀疏化。
在500图像场景下实现超过85%的加速，同时保持或提升基线性能。
cards.originalTitle: Good Token Hunting: A Hitchhiker's Guide to Token Selection for Visual Geometry Transformers
cards.limitationsEn: The abstract lacks details on experimental settings, datasets, and comprehensive comparisons with existing methods; speedup and performance retention may depend on specific scenes and model configurations; generality of the token selection strategy requires further validation.
keyPointsEn: Two-stage framework: inter-frame selection preserves key frames, and intra-frame selection discards redundant tokens.
Inter-frame selection uses a diversity-based strategy for scene coverage; intra-frame selection employs layer-aware sparsification guided by global attention entropy.
Achieves over 85% speedup on 500-image scenes while maintaining or improving baseline performance.
cards.whyItMatters: 该策略显著降低了视觉几何变换器的计算成本，提升了可扩展性和效率，为多视图三维重建的大规模应用提供了可行路径。
cards.summaryEn: Visual geometry transformers are powerful for multi-view 3D reconstruction, but global attention layers incur quadratic computational cost with input sequence length. The authors introduce a simple yet general strategy: restricting the number of key/value tokens each query interacts with during global attention. Experiments show over 85% acceleration on scenes with 500 images while maintaining or improving baseline performance.
cards.limitations: 摘要未提供具体实验设置、数据集细节及与现有方法的全面对比，加速效果和性能保持可能依赖于特定场景和模型配置；令牌选择策略的通用性需进一步验证。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This strategy significantly reduces computational cost and improves scalability and efficiency of visual geometry transformers, enabling feasible large-scale applications in multi-view 3D reconstruction.
cards.description: 该研究提出一种两阶段令牌选择框架，通过帧间多样性选择和帧内基于注意力熵的稀疏化，减少全局注意力中键/值令牌数量，从而在保持性能的同时加速视觉几何变换器。

cards.summary: 该开源项目提供一套 LLM 驱动的多市场股票智能分析系统，涵盖多源行情数据、实时新闻、决策看板与自动推送功能。项目声称支持零成本定时运行，但输入材料未给出具体实现方式与性能验证。整体而言，这是一个面向自动化股票分析的工程集成尝试，而非经过实证检验的投资策略。
cards.title: LLM 驱动多市场股票分析系统开源
cards.descriptionEn: This project combines large language models with multi-source market data and real-time news to automatically generate stock decision dashboards and push notifications, with claimed zero-cost scheduled runs. Its novelty lies in integrating the analysis pipeline and lowering the barrier to entry, offering individual researchers a reproducible reference implementation.
cards.titleEn: Open-Source LLM-Powered Multi-Market Stock Analysis System
keyPoints: 集成多源行情数据与实时新闻，由 LLM 生成分析并推送至决策看板。
提供自动化定时运行方案，并宣称可零成本部署。
面向多市场股票分析，但输入未说明具体覆盖的市场范围。
cards.limitationsEn: The input material is only a GitHub Trending project summary and lacks details on model selection, data sources, backtesting results, or live performance. The analysis accuracy, the practical feasibility of zero-cost operation, and the multi-market coverage cannot be verified. It should not be regarded as a validated quantitative strategy or investment advice.
keyPointsEn: Integrates multi-source market data and real-time news, with LLM-generated analysis pushed to a decision dashboard.
Provides an automated scheduled running solution and claims zero-cost deployment.
Targets multi-market stock analysis, but the input does not specify the exact market coverage.
cards.whyItMatters: 对于关注 AI 与量化交叉领域的研究者，该项目展示了如何将大语言模型、行情数据与新闻流整合为端到端的分析工具，可作为理解 LLM 在金融信息处理中应用方式的参考案例，但不构成任何投资依据。
cards.summaryEn: This open-source project provides an LLM-powered multi-market stock analysis system covering multi-source market data, real-time news, a decision dashboard, and automated notifications. It claims support for zero-cost scheduled runs, but the input material does not specify implementation details or performance validation. Overall, it is an engineering integration attempt for automated stock analysis rather than an empirically tested investment strategy.
cards.limitations: 输入材料仅为 GitHub Trending 的项目摘要，未提供模型选择、数据来源、回测结果或实盘表现等细节；无法验证其分析准确性、零成本运行的实际可行性及多市场覆盖范围；不应将其视为经过验证的量化策略或投资建议。
cards.whyItMattersEn: For researchers interested in the intersection of AI and quantitative finance, this project demonstrates how to integrate large language models, market data, and news streams into an end-to-end analysis tool. It can serve as a reference case for understanding how LLMs are applied to financial information processing, but it does not constitute any investment basis.
cards.description: 该项目将大语言模型与多源行情和实时新闻结合，自动生成股票决策看板并推送通知，且支持零成本定时运行；其新意在于整合分析流程并降低使用门槛，为个人研究者提供可复现的参考实现。

cards.summary: meta/astryx 是一个开源设计系统，来源简介称其完全可定制并面向智能体。现有信息仅给出这一定位描述，未披露实现方式、组件范围或使用案例。其实际价值与适用性需依据仓库内容进一步核实。
cards.title: meta/astryx：面向智能体的开源可定制设计系统
cards.descriptionEn: This entry profiles astryx, an open source design system described as fully customizable and agent ready. Its novelty lies in tying design-system tooling to agent use cases; it may be useful as a basis for customizable interfaces and agent interactions, though the repository details needed to verify capabilities are not provided.
cards.titleEn: meta/astryx: An Open Source, Customizable Design System for Agents
keyPoints: 定位为开源设计系统，强调完全可定制
来源简介称其 agent ready，即面向智能体场景
条目仅含仓库基本信息，未有技术细节或评测结果
cards.limitationsEn: The input contains only the repository name, source summary, and publication date; documentation, code structure, component list, license details, and any benchmarks or user feedback are missing. Performance, security, and production readiness cannot be inferred, and this is not a selection or investment recommendation.
keyPointsEn: Positioned as an open source design system emphasizing full customizability
The source summary describes it as agent ready
The entry contains only basic repository information, with no technical details or evaluation results
cards.whyItMatters: 若该设计系统确实兼顾可定制性与智能体使用需求，则可能为需要一致界面规范并接入智能体工作流的团队提供参考方向；但目前仅凭定位描述无法判断其成熟度与适用范围。

cards.title: RSI(2) 回调策略二十年回测：宣称84%胜率实测80.7%
cards.descriptionEn: A Quantocracy link roundup highlights a quantitative research piece noting that an RSI(2) pullback trading rule published in February 2007 was retested over the following two decades, with the originally claimed 84% win rate measured at 80.7%. This offers an independent long-term validation perspective on a classic strategy.
cards.titleEn: RSI(2) Pullback Strategy Over 20 Years: Claimed 84% Win Rate, Measured 80.7%
keyPoints: 2007 年 2 月有交易作者发布了一条简短的 RSI(2) 回调交易规则。
该规则在约二十年后被重新测试，宣称胜率 84%，实测胜率 80.7%。
来源为 Quantocracy 汇总链接，指向 Nullius Research。
cards.originalTitle: Recent Quant Links from Quantocracy as of 11/09/2026
cards.limitationsEn: This content is only a Quantocracy link summary and does not provide full backtest methodology, transaction costs, slippage, sample period details, or statistical significance tests. The difference between the measured 80.7% win rate and the claimed 84% may be affected by sample selection, changing market conditions, or execution assumptions, and cannot be used to infer future strategy performance. The summary does not include the author's explicit opinions or conclusions on strategy effectiveness.
keyPointsEn: In February 2007, a trading author published a short RSI(2) pullback trading rule.
The rule was retested about twenty years later: claimed win rate 84%, measured win rate 80.7%.
The source is a Quantocracy link roundup pointing to Nullius Research.
